subject: general
question: The tribal dancer and singer, Arjun Singh Dhurve from __________ has been conferred with 'Padma Shri' in the year 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madhya Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arjun Singh Dhurve** is a renowned tribal dancer and singer from **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• He has been recognized for his significant contribution to preserving and promoting the rich cultural heritage of the tribal communities in India.
 
• In the year **2022**, he was conferred with the prestigious **Padma Shri** award.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the **fourth highest civilian award **in India, given for distinguished service in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Madhya Pradesh** is known for its diverse cultural and traditional heritage, with numerous tribes contributing to its rich cultural tapestry.
 
• The state has a long history of honoring and celebrating its artists and performers, who play a crucial role in keeping the traditional art forms alive.
 
• The **Padma Awards** are announced annually **on the occasion of Republic Day** and are among the highest civilian honors in India.
 
• These awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri**, in decreasing order of importance.
